    • maxLimit

      public SELF maxLimit(Integer value)
      Overrides BeanQueryContext.Builder.maxLimit(Integer) for this session.

      If this session's defaultLimit was never explicitly set on this builder (it is still the value inherited from the context), narrowing maxLimit below it auto-narrows defaultLimit to match, rather than leaving the two in conflict. An explicitly-chosen defaultLimit is never silently changed by this setter — a resulting conflict is left for build() to reject.

      Parameters:
      value - The cap, or null for no cap. Must be positive if set.
      Returns:
      This object.
